Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: clawsec-suite
Version: 0.0.6

The OpenClaw AgentSkills skill bundle 'clawsec-suite' and its bundled security skills (clawsec-feed, openclaw-audit-watchdog, soul-guardian) are designed to enhance agent security. The suite demonstrates strong security practices, including checksum verification for all downloads, robust input validation (e.g., preventing shell injection in skill names, header injection in emails), atomic file operations, and tamper-evident audit logs. All network calls are to legitimate domains (prompt.security, github.com) for fetching security advisories or skill updates, and persistence mechanisms (cron, launchd) are explicitly documented and used for stated security monitoring purposes. There is no evidence of intentional harmful behavior, data exfiltration, or unauthorized remote control; instead, the skills actively monitor for such threats.
